name: Premium 6-in-1 Electric Baby Nail Trimmer Set | Safe Infant Nail Filer & Manicure Pedicure Kit with LED Light & Storage Case | Cell Operated | Random Color
description:
Keep your baby’s nails neat and well-groomed with this 6-in-1 Electric Baby Nail Trimmer Set, designed to provide a gentle and convenient alternative to traditional nail clippers. Its rotary filing system helps carefully trim and smooth delicate baby nails while the soft LED light provides better visibility during use. With multiple filing attachments, adjustable speed settings, protective design, and quiet operation, this compact nail trimmer is suitable for regular baby nail care at home or while traveling. The cell-operated design makes it easy to use without requiring a charging cable.

Key Features
6-in-1 electric baby nail trimmer and filing set
Gentle rotary filing system for baby nail care
Helps trim and smooth delicate nails
Multiple filing attachments for different nail-care needs
Adjustable speed settings for controlled trimming
Soft LED light for improved visibility
Quiet operation for a more comfortable nail-care experience
Protective design helps reduce the risk of accidental nicks
Compact and lightweight for easy handling and travel
Easy-to-clean detachable filing head
Suitable for baby manicure and pedicure care

Random color

How to Use
Select the appropriate filing attachment according to the baby's nail-care needs
Insert the attachment securely into the trimmer
Turn on the device and select a suitable speed
Use the LED light to clearly view the baby's nails
Gently move the filing head across the nail without applying excessive pressure
Trim and smooth the nails carefully
Turn off the device after use
Clean and store the attachments properly

Electric Nail Trimmer Body

LED Light

Safety Information
Use carefully and always supervise during baby nail care
Do not apply excessive pressure to the baby's nails or skin
Keep the device and attachments away from children when not in use
Use the appropriate attachment and speed for the baby's nails
Do not use on damaged or irritated skin
Keep the electrical components dry
Clean the detachable attachments regularly
